sources.system: The Diamondback Salary Guide (UMD student newspaper) - JSON API
sources.size: 2025: 10,963 rows; paged at 10 rows per page (~1,100 requests per year); page-size parameters ignored
sources.terms: not stated on API; Diamondback historically described the data as freely available to the public
sources.notes: Endpoint discovered in the site's JS bundle; verified /years and /year/2025 responses with a few spaced requests. Data comes from UMD via public records. Salary is a budgeted/annual salary, no other pay or FTE. Small page size means a full pull should be slow and polite (no robots.txt on api host - returns HTML error). Fields vary slightly by year (check older years).
